tools.name: klic_search
tools.title: Search KLIC library
tools.description: Search the public KLIC component and block catalog. Defaults to implemented items. This does not install code. Returns the shared designSystem criteria; review implementation responsibilities, preset boundaries and conflict resolution before implementation.

tools.name: klic_get_item
tools.title: Get KLIC item
tools.description: Read an item with shared designSystem rules, usage, accessibility, density, recovery, token mappings and DESIGN.md export.

tools.name: klic_get_contract
tools.title: Read KLIC capabilities
tools.description: Read the versioned designSystem rules, implementation responsibilities, preset boundaries, conflict resolution, integration capabilities and limitations.

tools.name: klic_get_install_plan
tools.title: Get KLIC source delivery plan
tools.description: Return a source bundle manifest and exact CLI commands for a ready item. Does not write files or execute commands. Returns the shared designSystem criteria; review implementation responsibilities, preset boundaries and conflict resolution before implementation.

tools.name: klic_list_themes
tools.title: List KLIC themes
tools.description: Read and search the theme catalog, supported profiles, materials and modes. Does not install or write files. Returns the shared designSystem criteria; review implementation responsibilities, preset boundaries and conflict resolution before implementation.

tools.name: klic_get_theme
tools.title: Get KLIC theme
tools.description: Read a theme with light and dark values and CSS import and application instructions. Returns the shared designSystem criteria; review implementation responsibilities, preset boundaries and conflict resolution before implementation.

tools.name: klic_get_theme_install_plan
tools.title: Get KLIC theme delivery plan
tools.description: Return a theme kit manifest and exact CLI commands for a selected profile, material and mode. Does not write files or execute commands. Returns the shared designSystem criteria; review implementation responsibilities, preset boundaries and conflict resolution before implementation.
